title: THC Advanced Canopy, Flowering and Reproductive Biology Certificate
publicDescription: Demonstrates applied advanced capability in canopy architecture, flowering execution, reproductive-risk recognition, evidence-based crop decisions, and controlled documentation.
limitations: This Academy credential is educational and employment-oriented; it is not a government cannabis license or occupational license.
